news.text: Trey Smack converted both of his field goal attempts as well as his only extra point attempt in the Packers' 26-13 loss to the Rams in Week 12.

news.text: KaVontae Turpin caught one of his three targets for 31 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for 10 yards in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.

Erste Defense-Snaps überhaupt in W3, als Chenal ausfiel: 5 Tackles, Pick-Six, Forced Fumble. Die 22,5 Punkte kommen großteils vom Touchdown, nicht vom Tackle-Volumen.
